summary: OPKO Health filed an 8-K on October 2, 2026, disclosing that its 3.75% Convertible Senior Notes due 2029, with roughly $121 million outstanding, became convertible by holders through December 31, 2026. The trigger was the common stock closing above $1.495, or 130% of the $1.15 conversion price, for at least 20 of 30 consecutive trading days in the quarter ended September 30, 2026. OPKO elected share settlement; each $1,000 principal converts into 869.5652 shares plus any early-conversion make-whole, per the Indenture with U.S. Bank Trust as trustee and conversion agent. Watch share-count dilution and potential holder conversions.
